caseTitle.en: Tremor and a headache in clinic

condition.zh: 慢性病 · 巴金森病與頭痛

tagline.zh: 看他走進來的十步，比問半小時還準
tagline.en: Watch the ten steps in; they say more than half an hour of questions

desc.zh: 門診日。一位手抖半年的退休校長、一位午休跑來看頭痛的護理師、一通病房的電話。
desc.en: Clinic day: a retired headteacher who has shaken for six months, a ward nurse who came in her lunch break with a headache, and a phone call from the ward.

desc.zh: 扣鈕扣、翻身、吞嚥、便秘、心情，你問得比誰都細。躺站血壓是你的招牌。
desc.en: Buttons, turning in bed, swallowing, constipation, mood: nobody asks more carefully. Lying-and-standing blood pressure is your trademark.

role.zh: 動作障礙科主治醫師（師傅）

about.zh: 病人從門口走到椅子的十步，她已經看完一半。口頭禪：「診斷在走廊，不在機器裡。」
about.en: Half the examination is done by the time the patient reaches the chair. Her line: 'The diagnosis is in the corridor, not in the machine.'

about.zh: 診間抽屜裡有一本「定時用藥」小卡，每一位新病人離開前都會拿到一張。
about.en: Keeps a drawer of 'medication on time' cards; every new patient leaves with one.

role.zh: 病人・68 歲退休小學校長

about.zh: 右手靜止時會抖半年了，字越寫越小。太太說他走路右手不擺，睡覺會大叫踢人。幾年前就聞不到味道。
about.en: Right hand has shaken at rest for six months and his writing is shrinking. His wife says the right arm no longer swings when he walks and he shouts and kicks in his sleep. Lost his sense of smell years ago.

about.zh: 帶了他以前寫黑板字的照片來，「他的字以前是全校最漂亮的」。
about.en: Brought a photo of his old blackboard handwriting: 'His was the most beautiful in the whole school.'

role.zh: 病人・34 歲病房護理師

about.zh: 午休跑來的。昨天飛輪課上突然一陣「這輩子最痛」的頭痛，吐了一次，今天還痛，脖子有點緊。「應該只是偏頭痛吧？」
about.en: Came in her lunch break. A sudden 'worst headache of my life' during spin class yesterday, vomited once, still hurting, neck a little stiff. 'It's probably just a migraine, right?'

about.zh: 病房有巴金森病人要禁食時，她一定打來問藥怎麼辦。
about.en: Whenever a Parkinson's patient is made nil by mouth on her ward, she calls to ask about the medication.

about.zh: 晚上打來報 CT 結果。他的問題永遠是「然後呢？」
about.en: Calls at night with the CT result. His question is always 'and then?'

plain.zh: 手放著不動時抖，拿東西反而比較不抖。像在搓藥丸。巴金森病的典型顫抖。
plain.en: Shaking when the hand is at rest, less when it is used; like rolling a pill. The typical Parkinson's tremor.

plain.zh: 被動轉動病人的手腕時，一格一格地卡，像齒輪。僵硬加上顫抖的結果。
plain.en: Turning the patient's wrist passively, it catches notch by notch like a cogwheel: rigidity with tremor laid over it.

plain.zh: 動作變慢、變小、重複做會越來越小。巴金森病診斷的核心，比顫抖更重要。
plain.en: Movements slow, shrink, and fade with repetition. The core of the diagnosis, more important than the tremor.

plain.zh: 字越寫越小、越寫越擠。常是家屬最早注意到的事。
plain.en: Handwriting that gets smaller and more cramped as it goes. Often the first thing a family notices.

plain.zh: 站起來血壓掉太多，頭暈眼黑。巴金森病本身和藥都會造成。要量躺著和站著的血壓。
plain.en: Blood pressure falling too far on standing: dizzy, vision greying. Both the disease and its drugs cause it. Measure lying and standing.

plain.zh: 顫抖出現前好幾年就有的訊號：聞不到味道、便秘、睡覺時大叫踢人、情緒低落。
plain.en: Signals that appear years before the tremor: lost smell, constipation, shouting and kicking in sleep, low mood.

term.zh: 快速動眼期睡眠行為障礙

plain.zh: 做夢時身體該是不會動的，這些人卻會把夢演出來：大叫、揮拳、踢腿。是最強的前驅症狀之一。
plain.en: The body should be still during dreams; these people act them out, shouting, punching, kicking. One of the strongest prodromal signs.

plain.zh: 幾秒內到達最痛的頭痛，「這輩子最痛」。排除蜘蛛膜下腔出血之前，不是偏頭痛。
plain.en: A headache that peaks within seconds, 'the worst of my life'. Until subarachnoid haemorrhage is excluded, it is not a migraine.

plain.zh: 腦表面血管（常是動脈瘤）破裂，血流進腦脊髓液裡。可以致命，也可以再破。
plain.en: Bleeding from a vessel on the brain surface, often an aneurysm, into the spinal fluid. It can kill, and it can bleed again.

plain.zh: 眼底的視神經盤腫起來，邊界模糊。代表顱內壓高。頭痛的病人一定要看眼底。
plain.en: The optic disc swollen with blurred margins: raised pressure inside the skull. Every headache patient gets a fundoscopy.

plain.zh: 站在病人後面，輕拉肩膀看他能不能站穩。後退超過兩步或要人接住，就是姿勢反射有問題。
plain.en: Standing behind the patient, a gentle tug on the shoulders. More than a couple of steps back, or needing to be caught, means impaired postural reflexes.

plain.zh: 巴金森病的藥晚了會動不了，突然停會很危險。禁食、住院、手術都要先問藥怎麼辦。
plain.en: Parkinson's drugs given late leave the patient unable to move; stopped suddenly they are dangerous. Nil by mouth, admission or surgery all start with 'what about the medication?'

plain.zh: 看起來像巴金森病但進展快、早跌倒、早失智、眼睛不會往下看、對藥反應差。要另外想。
plain.en: Looks like Parkinson's but progresses fast, with early falls, early dementia, eyes that will not look down, poor drug response. Think differently.

text.zh: 躺著量一次、站起來馬上量、站一段時間再量。數字寫下來，症狀也寫。
text.en: Once lying, once immediately on standing, once after standing a while. Write the numbers and the symptoms.

text.zh: 頭痛的病人看眼底不是加分題，是必考題。視乳頭水腫與出血都會在那裡等你。
text.en: Fundoscopy in a headache patient is not a bonus; it is compulsory. Papilloedema and haemorrhage wait there for you.

text.zh: 巴金森病的 MRI 多半正常，照它是為了排除別的。雷擊性頭痛的 CT 要看腦溝與基底池。
text.en: In Parkinson's the MRI is usually normal; it is done to exclude other things. In thunderclap headache the CT is read at the sulci and basal cisterns.

text.zh: 診間的標準測試：畫一個螺旋、寫一句話。右手的螺旋抖成鋸齒，句子越寫越小。
text.en: The clinic's standard test: draw a spiral, write a sentence. His right-hand spiral is sawtoothed, the sentence shrinks as it goes.

text.zh: 鄭太太帶來的。三十年前的粉筆字，大小一致、筆直。今天的螺旋放在它旁邊。
text.en: Brought by Mrs Cheng. Chalk handwriting from thirty years ago, even and straight. Today's spiral sits beside it.

text.zh: 小晴的卡片：藥的時間、禁食時要問誰、不能突然停。校長把它放進皮夾。
text.en: Ching's card: medication times, who to ask when nil by mouth, never stop suddenly. Mr Cheng slipped it into his wallet.

name.zh: 診斷在走廊，不在機器裡

text.zh: 巴金森病沒有驗血可以確診。診斷靠動作遲緩加上顫抖或僵硬、一側先開始、前驅症狀、對治療的反應。影像的角色是排除其他原因，以及在不典型時幫忙。病人問「要不要做 MRI 才確定」，答案是：確定來自檢查你，MRI 來自排除別的。
text.en: No blood test confirms Parkinson's. The diagnosis rests on bradykinesia plus tremor or rigidity, one-sided onset, prodromal symptoms and the response to treatment. Imaging exists to exclude other causes and to help when the picture is atypical. To 'do I need an MRI to be sure?' the answer is: certainty comes from examining you; the MRI rules out other things.

text.zh: 大多數頭痛是良性的，但幾個訊號一出現就要影像：突然幾秒到最痛、第一次或型態改變、年紀大才開始、有神經學異常、發燒或體重減輕、用力或姿勢引發、免疫低下或癌症病史。紅旗不是診斷，是「今天就要查」的指令。
text.en: Most headaches are benign, but a few signals demand imaging: peak within seconds, first or changed pattern, onset in later life, neurological signs, fever or weight loss, triggered by exertion or posture, immunosuppression or cancer. A red flag is not a diagnosis; it is an order to investigate today.

guide.en: Find Dr Wen at the desk

lines.zh: 早。今天滿診。第一位鄭校長，手抖半年，太太陪。他走進來的時候，你看什麼？
lines.en: Morning. Full list. First is Mr Cheng, six months of tremor, wife with him. When he walks in, what do you watch?

lines.zh: 手擺不擺、步幅、轉身、臉上的表情。
lines.en: Arm swing, stride, turning, the face.

lines.zh: 還有太太的表情。診斷在走廊，不在機器裡。
lines.en: And the wife's face. The diagnosis is in the corridor, not in the machine.

lines.zh: 新病人三位、複診十二位。鄭校長是新的，問卷先給太太填：睡覺會不會演夢、聞不聞得到、便秘。
lines.en: Three new patients, twelve follow-ups. Mr Cheng is new; the questionnaire goes to his wife first: acting out dreams, sense of smell, constipation.

lines.zh: 問卷比病人誠實。
lines.en: Questionnaires are more honest than patients.

note.zh: 校長的檢查與步態完成

lines.zh: 他從門口走到椅子：右手不擺、步子小、轉身分了四步。右手放在腿上，輕輕地搓。
lines.en: From the door to the chair: right arm still, short steps, four steps to turn. The right hand rests on his thigh, gently rolling.

lines.zh: 醫師，就是這隻手，不用的時候抖，拿杯子反而還好。
lines.en: Doctor, it's this hand. It shakes when I'm not using it; holding a cup it's actually fine.

lines.zh: 他字越寫越小。還有睡覺會大叫，踢我。好幾年前就說聞不到我煮的菜。
lines.en: His writing keeps getting smaller. And he shouts in his sleep and kicks me. Years ago he said he couldn't smell my cooking any more.

lines.zh: 不用時抖、用時好，是靜止性顫抖。字變小是小字症。
lines.en: Shaking at rest and settling in use is a resting tremor. The shrinking handwriting is micrographia.

lines.zh: 聞不到、便秘、演夢，叫前驅症狀，常常比手抖早好幾年。演夢那個叫快速動眼期睡眠行為障礙。
lines.en: Lost smell, constipation, acting out dreams: prodromal symptoms, often years before the tremor. The dream-acting is REM sleep behaviour disorder.

lines.zh: 所以我太太早就知道了？
lines.en: So my wife knew before I did?

lines.zh: 手腕讓我轉。感覺到了嗎？
lines.en: Let me turn the wrist. Feel that?

lines.zh: 一格一格的，齒輪狀僵硬。右邊明顯。手指快速開合，越做越小，動作遲緩。
lines.en: Notch by notch: cogwheel rigidity, worse on the right. Finger taps shrink as he goes: bradykinesia.

lines.zh: 顫抖是招牌，動作遲緩才是診斷。畫個螺旋給我。
lines.en: Tremor is the signboard; bradykinesia is the diagnosis. Draw me a spiral.

guide.en: Gait and pull test in the corridor

lines.zh: 走到底再回來。然後我站你後面，輕輕拉一下。
lines.en: To the end and back. Then I stand behind you and give a gentle tug.

lines.zh: 我以前升旗時走得最挺的。
lines.en: I used to walk the straightest at the flag ceremony.

lines.zh: 步幅小、右手不擺、轉身分步，拉力測試退一步自己站穩。單側起始，典型。
lines.en: Short stride, right arm still, turning in steps; one step back on the pull test and steady. One-sided onset, typical.

lines.zh: 校長，扣鈕扣、翻身、吞嚥、便秘、心情，一樣一樣跟我說。
lines.en: Mr Cheng, buttons, turning in bed, swallowing, constipation, mood, one at a time.

lines.zh: 鈕扣要太太幫。心情……退休後本來就悶。
lines.en: My wife does the buttons. Mood... I've been low since retiring anyway.

lines.zh: 心情也是這個病的一部分，不是你的錯。這張定時用藥小卡，之後開了藥，時間要準。
lines.en: Mood is part of this illness, not a failing. This 'medication on time' card: once you start treatment, the times matter.

note.zh: 診斷談清楚，姿勢性低血壓處理完

guide.en: Discuss the diagnosis with the couple

lines.zh: 校長，依檢查，這是巴金森病。單側開始、動作慢、僵硬、顫抖，加上多年的前驅症狀。
lines.en: Mr Cheng, on examination this is Parkinson's disease: one-sided onset, slowness, rigidity, tremor, and years of prodromal symptoms.

lines.zh: 要不要做 MRI 才能確定？
lines.en: Shouldn't I have an MRI to be sure?

q.zh: 病人問「要不要 MRI 才確定」，你怎麼答？
q.en: 'Do I need an MRI to be sure?' Your answer?

options.zh: 診斷是臨床的；MRI 用來排除其他原因，依醫囑安排
options.en: The diagnosis is clinical; the MRI excludes other causes and is arranged per protocol

why.zh: 對。確定來自檢查你，影像來自排除別的。兩件事都要說。
why.en: Right. Certainty comes from examining him; imaging rules out other things. Say both.

options.zh: 不用做，這絕對是巴金森
options.en: No need, this is definitely Parkinson's

why.zh: 「絕對」留給非典型巴金森去打臉。影像排除的那一步不能省。
why.en: 'Definitely' is what atypical parkinsonism loves to overturn. The exclusion step is not skipped.

options.zh: 先做 PET，沒有 PET 不能診斷
options.en: A PET scan first; no diagnosis without it

why.zh: 功能影像在不典型時才需要。典型的病人，檢查就是診斷。
why.en: Functional imaging is for atypical cases. In a typical patient the examination is the diagnosis.

post.zh: 會不會越來越糟？他還能帶孫子去公園嗎？
post.en: Will it get worse? Can he still take the grandchildren to the park?

post.zh: 會慢慢變，但有藥、有運動、有我們。公園要去，而且要常去。
post.en: It changes slowly, but there is treatment, exercise and us. The park: yes, and often.

guide.en: Mr Cheng is dizzy standing up

lines.zh: 我站一下……眼前黑黑的……
lines.en: Let me just stand... everything's going dark...

lines.zh: 他在家也這樣！
lines.en: He does this at home too!

options.zh: 躺下抬腿、量躺站血壓、檢查用藥與喝水
options.en: Lie him down, legs up, lying-and-standing pressures, review drugs and fluids

why.zh: 對。姿勢性低血壓是這個病的一部分。先安全，再量，再找原因。
why.en: Right. Orthostatic hypotension is part of this disease. Safety first, then measure, then look for causes.

options.zh: 給杯水，叫他慢慢走就好
options.en: A glass of water and tell him to walk slowly

why.zh: 沒有量過的頭暈不叫處理。他在家也會黑，下一次就是跌倒。
why.en: An unmeasured dizzy spell is not management. He greys out at home too; next time it is a fall.

options.en: Call an ambulance to the ER

why.zh: 躺下就好、血壓量得出來的姿勢性低血壓，門診處理。急診留給真正的急症。
why.en: Orthostatic hypotension that settles lying down with a measurable pressure is a clinic problem. The ER is for emergencies.

post.zh: 躺下就好了。原來這也是一起的。
post.en: Better lying down. So this is all part of it.

lines.zh: 校長，先躺著休息一下，我量一次；站起來馬上量一次；再站一段時間量一次。有症狀就說。
lines.en: Mr Cheng, rest lying down and I'll measure; then straight away on standing; then again after standing a while. Tell me any symptoms.

steps.en: Measure again after standing a while
Record the values and the symptoms

post.zh: 站起來掉很多、站久一點還是低，有症狀。寫上去，溫主治會調整計畫。
post.en: A big drop on standing, still low after a while, symptomatic. Written up; Dr Wen will adjust the plan.

note.zh: 禁食的巴金森病人：定時用藥不能停
note.en: Nil-by-mouth Parkinson's patient: time-critical medication continues

sub.zh: 怡文：「巴金森病人明天大腸鏡要禁食，藥怎麼辦？」
sub.en: Yi-wen: 'Parkinson's patient nil by mouth for tomorrow's colonoscopy. What about his medication?'

lines.zh: 醫師，5 床巴金森病人明天大腸鏡要禁食，他的藥是不是也停？
lines.en: Doctor, bed 5 is nil by mouth for tomorrow's colonoscopy. Do his Parkinson's drugs stop too?

lines.zh: 不能停。定時用藥，晚了會動不了，突然停會很危險。禁食時怎麼給，請藥師依流程建議，寫進醫囑。
lines.en: They do not stop. Time-critical medication: late and he cannot move, stopped suddenly and it is dangerous. Ask pharmacy how to give it while nil by mouth, per protocol, and write it in the orders.

lines.zh: 我就知道要打來問。
lines.en: I knew I should call.

lines.zh: 打來永遠是對的。我把這段寫在病歷，交班也要講。
lines.en: Calling is always right. I'll write it in the notes and it goes into handover.

note.zh: 小安：雷擊性頭痛，送急診
note.en: An: thunderclap headache, sent to the ER

guide.en: An squeezes in with a headache

lines.zh: 醫師不好意思，午休跑來的。昨天飛輪課突然一陣頭痛，這輩子最痛，吐了一次。應該只是偏頭痛吧？
lines.en: Sorry, Doctor, I ran over in my break. Yesterday in spin class a sudden headache, the worst of my life, vomited once. It's probably just a migraine?

lines.zh: 幾秒內到最痛？以前有過一樣的嗎？脖子呢？
lines.en: Peaked within seconds? Ever had one like it? And your neck?

lines.zh: 幾秒。沒有過。脖子有點緊。
lines.en: Seconds. Never. The neck's a bit stiff.

lines.zh: 這是雷擊性頭痛。排除蜘蛛膜下腔出血之前，不叫偏頭痛。先看眼底。
lines.en: That is a thunderclap headache. Until subarachnoid haemorrhage is excluded it is not a migraine. Fundus first.

guide.zh: 解釋為什麼今天就要掃
guide.en: Explain why the scan is today

lines.zh: 眼底沒有視乳頭水腫，但這改變不了決定。今天就要頭部 CT。
lines.en: No papilloedema, but that changes nothing. Head CT today.

lines.zh: 我下午還有班……
lines.en: I've got a shift this afternoon...

question.zh: 雷擊性頭痛的頭部 CT 要看哪裡？CT 正常就能回家嗎？
question.en: Where do you look on the CT in thunderclap headache, and does a normal CT mean she can go home?

answer.zh: 腦溝、腦裂與基底池有沒有高密度的血。越早掃越準；症狀超過幾小時後 CT 正常仍不能排除，要依流程腰椎穿刺或血管影像。
answer.en: For high-density blood in the sulci, fissures and basal cisterns. The earlier the scan the more reliable; once hours have passed a normal CT does not exclude it, and lumbar puncture or vessel imaging follows per protocol.

post.zh: 小安，班請人代。這不是偏頭痛的處理方式，這是紅旗的處理方式。
post.en: An, get your shift covered. This is not how we treat a migraine; it is how we treat a red flag.

post.zh: 我在病房也是這樣勸病人的。
post.en: That's what I tell my own patients on the ward.

note.zh: 師傅的回顧；個管師的追蹤計畫
note.en: The mentor's debrief; the nurse's follow-up plan

lines.zh: 今天兩個病人。哪一個比較急？
lines.en: Two patients today. Which was the urgent one?

lines.zh: 手抖半年的那位不急；「只是偏頭痛」的那位最急。
lines.en: Not the six months of tremor; the 'just a migraine' was the urgent one.

lines.zh: 對。慢性病的門診裡，最危險的是走進來說「應該沒事」的人。
lines.en: Right. In a chronic-disease clinic the most dangerous person is the one who walks in saying 'it's probably nothing'.

guide.zh: 溫主治提起 MRI 那題
guide.en: Dr Wen brings up the MRI question

lines.zh: 上午你跟校長說「絕對是巴金森」。
lines.en: This morning you told Mr Cheng it was 'definitely Parkinson's'.

lines.zh: 他太典型了。
lines.en: He was so typical.

lines.zh: 典型的也要排除。非典型巴金森最喜歡打臉說「絕對」的人。
lines.en: Typical cases still get the exclusion. Atypical parkinsonism loves people who say 'definitely'.

guide.zh: 溫主治提起 MRI 那題
guide.en: Dr Wen brings up the MRI question

lines.zh: 上午你說沒有 PET 不能診斷。
lines.en: This morning you said no diagnosis without a PET scan.

lines.zh: 我想要更確定。
lines.en: I wanted to be more certain.

lines.zh: 確定來自你的手和眼睛。機器留給不典型的那一天。
lines.en: Certainty comes from your hands and eyes. Save the machine for the atypical day.

lines.zh: 計畫：定時用藥、每天走路、躺站血壓在家量、便秘與情緒追蹤、跌倒預防、太太的支持團體。
lines.en: Plan: medication on time, a daily walk, lying-and-standing pressures at home, constipation and mood follow-up, fall prevention, a support group for his wife.

lines.zh: 加一行：下次回診帶新的螺旋來。
lines.en: One more line: bring a new spiral next visit.

note.zh: 小安的 CT 正常：依流程往下查
note.en: An's CT normal: investigation continues per protocol

sub.zh: 黃醫師：「你們門診送來的護理師，CT 正常。然後呢？」
sub.en: Dr Huang: 'Your clinic's nurse, CT normal. And then?'

lines.zh: 雷擊性頭痛那位，CT 正常。她說可以回家上班了嗎？
lines.en: The thunderclap headache: CT normal. She's asking if she can go home and go to work.

q.zh: 雷擊性頭痛發作超過一天，CT 正常，你的建議？
q.en: Thunderclap headache more than a day old, CT normal. Your advice?

options.zh: CT 正常不夠，依流程腰椎穿刺或血管影像
options.en: A normal CT is not enough; lumbar puncture or vessel imaging per protocol

why.zh: 對。超過幾小時後 CT 的敏感度會掉。紅旗要查到底。
why.en: Right. CT sensitivity falls after the first hours. A red flag is investigated to the end.

why.zh: 被漏掉的蜘蛛膜下腔出血，第二次破的時候不會給你機會。
why.en: A missed subarachnoid haemorrhage gives no second chance when it rebleeds.

why.zh: 偏頭痛是排除之後的診斷，不是今晚的。
why.en: Migraine is a diagnosis of exclusion, and tonight nothing has been excluded.

post.zh: 收到。她說「我就知道你們會這樣講」。
post.en: Got it. She says 'I knew you'd say that'.

lines.zh: 一個走廊、一個螺旋、一通電話、一面紅旗。
lines.en: One corridor, one spiral, one phone call, one red flag.

lines.zh: 值班結束。診桌上，三十年前的黑板字照片旁邊，放著今天的螺旋。
lines.en: End of shift. On the clinic desk, beside the thirty-year-old blackboard photo, lies today's spiral.

sub.zh: 診斷在走廊，紅旗在午休
sub.en: The diagnosis was in the corridor; the red flag came at lunch
